summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py, which handles all eight depot formats and the shared export conventions (gzip, BOM and charset, mid-file headers and directives, per-row units, layout switching, UTC conversion), the correction, void and resend rules, and handovers. It ran on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and check_summary.py reports that every value matches the reference figures.
